purpose: Research-only live Common Sense Media refetch for data-mcudc.js catalog nums 686-705. Do not treat as production data until reviewed and transformed through the official workflow.

contentFlagModel.mappingNote: This refetch preserves CSM's visible category label and proposes the nearest app level. Labels of 'none' and 'not present' map to level 1; 'very little' and 'a little' map to level 2; 'some' maps to level 3; 'a lot' maps to level 4.

entries.title: Batman

violence.summary: Shoot-outs, fights, chases, on-screen killings, childhood parental murder flashbacks, lethal Joker attacks, ledge peril, bladed weapons, and a suicide reference.

language.summary: Several mild-to-moderate profanities, including censored stronger words and insults.

romance.summary: Implied sex, Joker's unwanted sexual advances, and prostitutes visible in a city street scene.

drinking.summary: Cigar and cigarette smoking plus champagne drinking with a woman shown drunk after dinner.

handoffNotes: Emotional/sad prose should retain Bruce witnessing his parents' murder and the parallel child-witnessed killing.

entries.title: Batman Returns

language.summary: Mild obscenity and repeated double entendres, including one crude sexual term.

romance.summary: Batman and Catwoman fight in sexually charged ways, including straddling imagery and suggestive banter.

drinking.summary: No drinking, drugs, or smoking concern surfaced in CSM's category data.

handoffNotes: Live CSM language label/details conflict with the earlier screening pass, which treated language as absent.
Emotional/sad prose should retain child abandonment, death, and corporate corruption themes.
